title: double rod garment rack
text: double rod garment rack. I have a closet with a REALLY tall bar... I needed a second bar and didn't want to loose all the storage in my closet lower area.  This seemed like a good idea.  I put it together, by myself in about 20 minutes.  I am going to say that I could not install the wheels, they just would not screw in - 3 of the 4 would not.  It's like the screw holes were crooked or something... but as it turned out, it fit better without the wheels and since I don't plan on moving it and out.. it was ok not to have the wheels on.  I would say that someone stronger might have been able to force screw the wheels in, just not an option for me. The measurements given were accurate. I didn't realize that it was black with the silver hanging rods... (thought it was all silver) but again, that really didn't matter to me. You've gotta watch what you're buying for color! In any case, the price was right.  FYI... I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews... my purchases are VERIFIED, full price, fully independent purchases.  100%  As are my reviews!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and always try to respond to questions and comments.  Happy Shopping!
